l4_steps.name: Initiate annual planning cycle in SAP S/4HANA
l4_steps.input: Board-approved strategic plan, prior-year close confirmation
l4_steps.output: Planning calendar with milestones and owner assignments
l4_steps.kpi: Planning cycle launched ≥12 weeks before fiscal year-end
l4_steps.pain_point: Misalignment between network planning schedule (Amadeus SkyWORKS) and finance calendar delays capacity cost assumptions by 2–3 weeks

l4_steps.name: Extract prior-year actuals from SAP FI/CO
l4_steps.input: Year-end close completion flag in SAP
l4_steps.output: Actuals data set by cost centre, profit centre, and GL account
l4_steps.kpi: Actuals extraction completed within 3 business days of year-end close
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual reclassification of intercompany recharges between airline OpCo and MRO subsidiary inflates cost centre variances by up to 8%

l4_steps.name: Pull macro & fuel price assumptions
l4_steps.input: Spot fuel prices, FX forwards, GDP and CPI consensus forecasts
l4_steps.output: Approved macro assumption set (fuel, FX, inflation) for planning year
l4_steps.kpi: Fuel price assumption reviewed against IATA Jet Fuel Monitor within ±5% of market consensus
l4_steps.pain_point: Jet fuel price volatility (±40% year-on-year) makes fixed planning assumptions obsolete within Q1; no direct feed from Bloomberg into SAP BPC requiring manual re-entry

l4_steps.name: CFO review and approval of planning assumptions
l4_steps.input: Macro assumption pack from Treasury, strategic volume targets from Network Planning
l4_steps.output: Approved assumption sign-off memo published to all budget owners
l4_steps.kpi: Assumptions approved and published within 5 business days of Treasury submission
l4_steps.pain_point: Late delivery of network capacity plan from Amadeus SkyMAX optimisation run blocks CFO sign-off; fleet assignment iterations can extend 2+ weeks past planning calendar

l4_steps.name: Distribute budget templates via SAP BPC
l4_steps.input: Approved planning assumptions, prior-year actuals, approved headcount baseline
l4_steps.output: Pre-populated budget input templates distributed to 40+ cost centre managers
l4_steps.kpi: Templates distributed within 2 business days of assumption approval
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP BPC template version conflicts when cost centre hierarchy changes mid-cycle (e.g., post-restructuring) cause data submission errors requiring IT intervention

l4_steps.name: Departments enter cost centre budgets in SAP BPC
l4_steps.input: Distributed budget templates, departmental headcount plan
l4_steps.output: Departmental P&L budget and headcount plan submitted in SAP BPC
l4_steps.kpi: On-time submission rate ≥90% of cost centres by stated deadline
l4_steps.pain_point: Operational departments (Ground Ops, Crew Planning) lack financial modelling skills; submissions frequently contain formula errors, requiring FP&A rework averaging 3 days per cycle

l4_steps.name: Validate completeness of departmental submissions
l4_steps.input: All departmental budget submissions in SAP BPC
l4_steps.output: Submission completeness report; escalation notices to overdue cost centres
l4_steps.kpi: 100% submission completeness achieved before consolidation window opens
l4_steps.pain_point: No automated reminder workflow in SAP BPC; FP&A team manually tracks submissions via spreadsheet, introducing version control risk

l4_steps.name: Validate headcount budget vs SAP SuccessFactors plan
l4_steps.input: Departmental headcount submissions, approved establishment file from SuccessFactors
l4_steps.output: Reconciled headcount budget with variance commentary for exceptions >5 FTE
l4_steps.kpi: Headcount variance between BPC submission and SuccessFactors plan ≤2% at department level
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP SuccessFactors and SAP BPC do not share a live integration; headcount data exported via flat-file weekly, causing stale data when departments submit after the extract cut-off

l4_steps.name: Validate capex requests against fleet and route plan
l4_steps.input: Departmental capex bids, Amadeus SkyMAX fleet assignment output, Boeing delivery schedule
l4_steps.output: Approved capex budget list with project codes assigned in SAP CO
l4_steps.kpi: Capex budget total reconciled to strategic fleet plan within ±2% variance
l4_steps.pain_point: Boeing 737 MAX delivery slippages (historically 6–18 months) invalidate fleet-linked capex budgets; no automated feed from Boeing delivery portal into SAP CO requiring manual re-phasing

l4_steps.name: Consolidate full P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet
l4_steps.input: All validated departmental budgets and capex lists
l4_steps.output: Consolidated airline-level budget P&L, cash flow statement, and balance sheet
l4_steps.kpi: Consolidation completed within 3 business days of submission deadline
l4_steps.pain_point: Intercompany eliminations between airline, MRO entity, and loyalty programme require manual journal entries in SAP BPC; risk of double-counting revenue estimated at 1–2% of group revenue

l4_steps.name: Assess consolidated budget vs EBITDAR target
l4_steps.input: Consolidated budget P&L, Board-approved EBITDAR target range
l4_steps.output: Gap analysis report: budget EBITDAR vs target with sensitivity scenarios
l4_steps.kpi: EBITDAR margin target ≥15% on consolidated airline revenue
l4_steps.pain_point: Fuel and labour costs (>65% of OPEX) are largely non-discretionary; gap closure options are limited and CFO pressure to cut maintenance capex risks AOG rate increases in Y+1

l4_steps.name: Issue cut targets and iterate with cost centres
l4_steps.input: EBITDAR gap analysis, CFO direction on cost reduction quantum
l4_steps.output: Revised departmental budget targets distributed; resubmission timeline set
l4_steps.kpi: Resubmission cycle completed within 5 business days of cut target issuance
l4_steps.pain_point: Repeated iteration loops (average 2.3 rounds per cycle) extend the planning calendar into operational freeze windows, increasing risk of budget being published after the fiscal year has started

l4_steps.name: Reconcile fuel hedge positions with treasury model
l4_steps.input: Confirmed fuel hedge book from Treasury, consolidated fuel volume budget from Operations
l4_steps.output: Hedged and unhedged fuel cost budget with sensitivity at ±10% fuel price
l4_steps.kpi: Hedge coverage ratio target ≥50% of planned fuel consumption for next 12 months
l4_steps.pain_point: Fuel hedging positions managed in Bloomberg are not natively visible in SAP BPC; hedge P&L impact must be manually bridged, introducing a reporting lag of up to 5 business days

l4_steps.name: Prepare executive budget pack for Board presentation
l4_steps.input: Approved consolidated budget, sensitivity scenarios, prior-year comparison
l4_steps.output: Board budget pack: executive summary, key metrics dashboard, risk narrative
l4_steps.kpi: Board pack delivered ≥5 business days before Finance Committee meeting
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual export of SAP BPC data into Tableau introduces version risk; FP&A teams maintain parallel Excel models that diverge from SAP BPC source of truth, undermining data integrity

l4_steps.name: Present budget to Board Finance Committee
l4_steps.input: Executive budget pack, audit committee pre-read, external auditor sign-off
l4_steps.output: Board meeting minutes with approval resolution or revision instructions
l4_steps.kpi: Board approval obtained at first presentation in ≥75% of annual cycles
l4_steps.pain_point: Board members may request scenario re-runs (e.g., different fuel assumptions) that SAP BPC cannot perform live in the board room; delays approval by 1–2 weeks

l4_steps.name: Lock approved budget baseline in SAP BPC and SAP CO
l4_steps.input: Board approval resolution, final budget version in SAP BPC
l4_steps.output: Locked budget version in SAP BPC; approved cost centre budgets released to SAP CO for actuals comparison
l4_steps.kpi: Budget locked and released to SAP CO within 3 business days of Board approval
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP BPC version locking does not prevent ad-hoc manual adjustments via SAP CO cost centre planning; shadow budgets maintained by operations managers erode single-source-of-truth discipline

l4_steps.name: Generate monthly actuals vs budget variance report
l4_steps.input: Monthly close actuals from SAP FI, locked budget baseline from SAP BPC
l4_steps.output: Monthly management accounts pack with variance commentary by cost centre
l4_steps.kpi: Management accounts published within 5 business days of month-end close
l4_steps.pain_point: Month-end close extended by late Accounts Payable accruals from MRO vendors (average 3–4 day delay post month-end); delays variance reporting and triggers reforecast discussions without complete data

l4_steps.name: Assess variance against materiality threshold
l4_steps.input: Monthly variance report, materiality threshold (±5% revenue or ±$2M EBITDAR)
l4_steps.output: Variance assessment decision: maintain budget or trigger rolling reforecast
l4_steps.kpi: Reforecast trigger decision made within 2 business days of management accounts publication
l4_steps.pain_point: Absence of a formal materiality policy means reforecast decisions are made ad-hoc; in fuel price spike scenarios (e.g., geopolitical events), Finance may be 6–8 weeks behind market reality

l4_steps.name: Execute rolling reforecast and update SAP BPC
l4_steps.input: Latest actuals, revised macro assumptions, updated capacity plan from Amadeus SkyCAST
l4_steps.output: Updated 12-month rolling forecast published in SAP BPC; variance to original budget flagged
l4_steps.kpi: Rolling reforecast cycle completed within 10 business days of trigger; forecast accuracy ≤3% vs subsequent actuals
l4_steps.pain_point: Revenue reforecast requires Amadeus NRM booking-curve data that is not available in SAP BPC; FP&A manually requests extracts from Revenue Management team, adding 2–3 day dependency
